title: craspedia chrysantha
intro: Craspedia chrysantha, commonly known as Billy Buttons, is a flowering plant native to Australia. The plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Craspedia chrysantha include reducing anxiety and stress, and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects, although more research is needed to confirm the exact mechanisms.
